seo.title: Mila Parsec — Brand & Graphic Designer
seo.description: Mila Parsec is a brand & graphic designer working remotely across Europe and beyond: visual identities, social media and ad campaigns, packaging, print and wayfinding.

hero.imageAlt: Luscofusco 19 perfume bottle with a stone cap
hero.intro:
Brand & graphic designer working remotely across Europe and beyond.
Seven years of turning clear ideas into memorable brands, on screen, in print and in physical space.
hero.availability: Open to new roles & freelance work

rows.label: What I do
rows.text: I build complete brands, from identity and digital to print and physical space, and lead them from first concept to production-ready files. AI tools are part of my everyday workflow, always art-directed by hand.

rows.label: My background
rows.text: Based in Prague, I studied graphic design and interactive graphics and have been practising for seven years. I’ve worked in-house at a publishing house, as the first employee of a fashion atelier and independently with festivals, production studios, cafés and photographers.

rows.label: My approach
rows.text: Every brand starts with one clear idea. I listen, ask questions and look for the thought that holds everything together, then make sure it works everywhere: on a phone screen, a printed label or a concrete wall.

items.head: (2024 – 2026) In-house Designer at First Class Publishing
items.note: Identity for Mynds Festival (10,000+ attendees) and paid Meta campaigns with a €5,000–10,000 monthly spend.

items.head: (2020 – 2024) Merch & Embroidery Designer at Iris Ateliér
items.note: First employee: ran the whole merch process, from design and production files to embroidery-machine manufacturing.

items.head: (2019 – now) Independent Brand & Graphic Designer
items.note: Brands for Rubin Production (client since 2020), Alla Vakker, Scooty.cz and Game Changer Academy; wayfinding for Space Cafe.

items.head: Václav Hollar High School of Art, Prague

rows.label: Tools
rows.text: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, WordPress, CapCut. AI: Claude Design, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Kling, Lovable.
